children.label: Original source instructions
children.help_text:
Instructions:

This form allows you to attach a PHS 398 Training Budget form for each subaward/consortium associated with your application. Use the "Click here to extract the PHS 398 Training Subaward Attachment" button to extract a blank copy of the PHS 398 Training Budget form, complete the form in accordance with the agency instructions, and attach the completed form using one of the "Add Attachment" buttons.



Important: 

Attach Training Subaward Budget forms, using the blocks below. Remember that the files you attach must be PHS 398 Training Budget PDF forms, which were previously extracted using the process outlined above. Attaching any other type of file may result in the inability to submit your application to Grants.gov.

Original template-extraction instruction: Click here to extract the PHS 398 Training Subaward Budget Attachment

The Adobe Acrobat PDF version of the PHS 398 Training Budget Form will be compressed and embedded into this form.  The applicant will click the button and a dialog box will appear, at which point the applicant indicates where to save the file.

The extraction button belongs to the original PDF workflow. This preview displays the instruction and accepts illustrative file references; it does not extract a template, upload a file or submit a budget.

children.label: Training subaward budget files
children.help_text: Attach up to 30 completed PHS 398 Training Budget PDF forms in their original extracted format. Do not re-PDF the form. Use the completed original Training Budget form for each subaward/consortium.

notes: The original DAT and XSD make all source attachment slots optional (0–30). Agency/program requirements remain additional instructions; do not impose an invented minimum of one file.

Finite XML slot bindings preserve each ATT1–ATT30 source coordinate. The capture list is ordered and compact; actual service assignment to numbered source slots remains integration work, not arbitrary sparse-slot round-trip proof.

Source ATTn elements are xs:string file references. The current library Attachment scalar is a UUID service reference. This is an explicit capture projection, not a serializer that writes UUIDs as source file descriptors.

BudgetAttachments contains full imported completed-budget XML. The explicit External form source reference preserves that separate derived-payload channel; the child budget is not modeled as inline applicant questions, compiled or qualified by this definition.

Template extraction, actual PDF format/content, original-template preservation, filename conventions/uniqueness, file existence/ownership and source XML construction require real application/attachment integration. No upload or XML mapping is implemented here.
No equivalent implementation was found by the pinned SGG inventory at48d93f882c63a711bdec4b16e3150d1293cdff43. Existing-SGG behavior/runtime parity is not claimed.
Original source instructions, extraction wording and important warning are preserved in displayed plan/layout prose. The template-extraction control is not represented as a fake working button.
